items.title: Research (Polish): How much should a phone page show before the reader opens anything, and how should the rest be offered?
items.content_text: Show what most readers need first and put the rest one clear, well-labelled step away. Two levels is the useful limit. This backs the More about cards on Team and the Lessons and Cases trims (d7) rather than adding new layers.

items.title: Research (Pixel): What can an SVG avatar loaded with an img tag do, now that the holiday blobs animate inside their own files?
items.content_text: An SVG used as an image runs no scripts and loads no outside files, so the avatars must keep their CSS and shapes inline, as scripts/avatars.py already does. Nothing to change.

items.title: Research (Advocate): What problems do Grok Bot users hit often enough that the official changelog keeps fixing them?
items.content_text: The 0.71.2 notes fix many problems around a Bot's computer being asleep, waking or reconnecting. That points to a reader need for a plain note on what a sleeping computer means, but it stays a hypothesis until real reader feedback says so.
